263: Whether with beasts, with [wild] animals, with fowl or with fish of the sea, there is right and left (mercy and strict judgement) seen in them. And it is permitted for us to eat from anyone who comes from the side of the right (from the side of mercy). But it is forbidden for us to eat from anyone who comes from the side of the left (from the side of strict justice). This is on account of the level (other books, that the essence) of all of them being impure; so that they all are impure and a spirit of impurity rests upon them and dwells within them. And therefore the holy spirit of the Jewish people cannot mix with them, so that it not become impure from them. For holiness should be found within them, so they can be known above and below. Fortunate is the portion of the Jewish people, for the holy King desires them and wants to purify them and to sanctify them over everything, because they cling to Him.
